statement: For every finite simple graph G with adjacent common-neighbor count exactly1 and nonadjacent common-neighbor count exactly2, every induced H=G[S], every x outside S, and T=N_G(x) intersect S, every u in S satisfies |N_H(u) intersect T|<=1 if u belongs to T and <=2 otherwise.

scope.population: Every finite simple graph with exact adjacentCN1/nonadjacentCN2, every induced support subset and every exterior vertex; all support vertices, no degree/order/regularity restriction.

assumptions: H is the induced graph on S, x outside S and T=N_G(x) intersect S

controls.written_theorem_proof: Identity injection into the common-neighbor set of the distinct pair u,x; adjacency equivalent to u in T.
